cover.title: ai, agi, asi, si: 4 words that make you sound dangerously cracked

inner.title: ai: the boring one
inner.body: under us law, ai is a machine-based system making predictions, recommendations or decisions for human-set objectives. nothing in that definition requires it to be smart.

inner.title: agi: nobody agrees
inner.body: agi means systems that outperform humans at most economically valuable work, per openai's charter. there's no agreed test, and nothing meets that bar yet.

inner.title: asi: doesn't exist
inner.body: asi is an intellect that greatly exceeds humans in virtually all domains, per bostrom's 2014 definition. calling your product superintelligent claims something nobody has built.

inner.title: si: same thing, renamed
inner.body: si is the federal name for today's ai, set by an executive order signed september 29, 2026. it creates no new definition, so si legally equals ai.

inner.title: watch november 28
inner.body: a federal si definition proposal is due november 28, 2026. until congress acts, say 'ai (also called si)' and never call it superintelligent.

closer.HEADLINE:
two mean the same.
two don't exist yet.
closer.SUBLINE: say ai. add si. never claim asi.
